speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that detail. Given your consumption of unpasteurized dairy products 3 days before symptom onset, have you noticed any significant abdominal pain or diarrhea since becoming sick? Also, have you been exposed to anyone recently diagnosed with listeriosis or who has had a fever?
